items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And then Chuck Mangione was there, he came and he supported that.

ctx.x: And then Chuck Mangione was there, he came and he supported that. And I don’t know what it is now but I’m sure it’s been rescinded, but the lead trumpet got 50% over scale. So when we played together we took that 50% and split it up.
